description: Use when you need keyword ideas people actually type: SEO long-tail and question keywords, YouTube title/tag ideas, or Amazon listing and PPC search terms. Reads the public Google Suggest, YouTube suggest and Amazon search-box completion feeds for one seed (country + language aware) and returns deduped suggestions with source, rank position, relevance (Google/YouTube) and the exact query sent. expand=alphabet adds seed+a..z (one source per call), questions adds how/what/why/... prefixes, prepositions adds for/with/vs/..., numbers adds 0-9. Errors and empty results are not charged. For bulk runs (many seeds, all expansions) use the Apify Actor https://apify.com/scrapemole/keyword-autocomplete-scraper. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.003 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

country.description: Two-letter country (also picks the Amazon marketplace: US, GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SE, PL, CA, MX, BR, AU, JP, IN).

expand.description: Expansion: none, alphabet (seed a..z, one source per call), questions, prepositions or numbers. Max 40 autocomplete requests per call.

lang.description: Language for Google and YouTube suggestions (en, de, pt-BR).
